Meet Jordyn

Birth work is
my calling

Hi, I’m Jordyn — a certified doula serving families across the Minneapolis and St. Paul metro. I believe that every birthing person deserves to feel informed, supported, and genuinely empowered throughout their journey into parenthood.

My approach is rooted in deep listening and genuine presence. Whether you’re planning a home birth, a hospital birth, or something in between, I’m here to walk alongside you — never ahead of you. Your birth, your choices, your story.

Presence

Fully there for you, physically and emotionally, every step

Advocacy

Helping you feel confident speaking up for your own care

Trust

Your body knows what to do — I’m here to remind you

Services & Pricing

Support for every chapter

From your first prenatal visit through the early weeks at home, I offer personalized packages designed to meet you right where you are.

Birth Doula

Full Support

Continuous, hands-on support throughout your labor and delivery, plus dedicated prenatal and postpartum care.

  • Two prenatal visits (in-home or virtual)
  • Personalized birth plan guidance
  • On-call support from 38 weeks
  • Continuous labor & delivery support
  • Comfort measures & partner coaching
  • One postpartum follow-up visit
  • Phone & text support throughout
$900 / package
Most Popular

Birth + Postpartum

Complete Care

Everything in the Birth Doula package, plus extended postpartum support to ease your transition into life with baby.

  • Everything in Birth Doula package
  • Three postpartum visits (in-home)
  • Newborn care basics & feeding support
  • Emotional check-ins & resource referrals
  • Light household help during visits
  • Extended phone & text support (8 weeks)
$1,200 / package

Postpartum Doula

Flexible Hours

Dedicated in-home support during the weeks after birth. Rest, recover, and adjust while I help care for you and your baby.

  • Daytime in-home support visits
  • Newborn care & soothing techniques
  • Breastfeeding & feeding support
  • Sibling adjustment assistance
  • Meal prep & light housekeeping
  • Emotional support & encouragement
$40 / hour

Flexible payment plans available · Let’s find what works for your family

The Journey

What to expect

Working together is simple and personal. Here’s how our relationship unfolds from the very first hello.

01

Free Discovery Call

A relaxed 20–30 minute conversation to get to know each other, talk about your birth vision, and see if we’re a good fit. No pressure, no commitment.

02

Prenatal Visits

We’ll meet to dive deep into your birth preferences, practice comfort techniques, and build a plan that reflects exactly what you want. Partners always welcome.

03

On-Call & Labor

Starting at 38 weeks, I’m on call around the clock. When labor begins, I’ll join you at your chosen birth location and stay by your side through delivery.

04

Postpartum Care

After baby arrives, I’ll visit you at home to check in on recovery, help with early feeding, answer questions, and make sure you feel supported.

Common Questions

Let’s clear things up

A doula provides continuous physical, emotional, and informational support before, during, and after birth. I’m not a medical provider — I’m your dedicated support person. Think of me as your calm, knowledgeable companion who helps you feel confident and cared for. I offer comfort techniques, help you understand your options, and support your partner too.

Absolutely not! I love working alongside partners. I help them feel confident and involved by suggesting ways they can comfort you and giving them the support they need to be fully present. Most partners say having a doula made them feel more connected to the birth, not less.

Not at all. I support you in whatever birth feels right for you — whether that’s unmedicated, with an epidural, or a planned cesarean. There is no one “right” way to give birth. My job is to make sure you feel informed about your choices and supported no matter what path your birth takes.

Most families reach out during the second trimester, but I’m happy to connect at any point. The earlier we start, the more time we have to build a relationship and prepare together — but it’s never too late. Even in your third trimester, I’d love to hear from you.

Yes! I understand that growing a family comes with a lot of expenses. I offer flexible payment plans and am happy to work with you to find an arrangement that fits your budget. Doula care should be accessible, and I never want cost to be the reason someone goes without support.

I serve families throughout the Minneapolis–St. Paul metro area including surrounding suburbs. If you’re a bit further out, let’s chat — I’m often willing to travel for the right fit. Virtual prenatal and postpartum visits are also available for added flexibility.
